text: ✨ Seongnam–Amsterdam K-Beauty Business Delegation 2026 ✨ On Thursday, October 1, 2026, the Seongnam–Amsterdam K-Beauty Business Delegation will take place in Amsterdam! 💄🇰🇷 Discover Korea’s next wave of beauty innovation and connect directly with promising Korean K-Beauty companies through curated one-on-one business meetings. Whether you are an importer, distributor, retailer, beauty professional, or industry partner, this exclusive event offers a valuable opportunity to discover innovative products and explore potential business partnerships. 💗 FEATURED K-BEAUTY SECTORS 🧴 Performance Skincare ✨ Beauty Devices 💄 Beauty Tools & Lifestyle Products 🤝 CURATED ONE-ON-ONE BUSINESS MEETINGS Meetings will be arranged based on product categories, business interests, and distribution channels, helping participating buyers connect with the most relevant Korean companies. 📍 EVENT INFORMATION 📅 Date: Thursday, October 1, 2026 ⏰ Time: 09:00–18:00 📍 Venue: NH Amsterdam Zuid 🔖 Admission: Invitation only 📲 DISCOVER THE PARTICIPATING COMPANIES Interested in discovering innovative K-Beauty products and potential business partners? Scan the QR code on the poster to explore the participating Korean companies and view their product brochures. Be among the first to discover Korea’s emerging beauty brands and explore new partnership opportunities in the European market. 💗 We look forward to welcoming you in Amsterdam!
